title: Priesthood of Believers
definition: The Priesthood of Believers teaches that all Christians have access to God through Christ and are called to offer spiritual sacrifices.
summary: Every believer may draw near to God through the one Mediator, Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the great High Priest who opens access to the Father for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Priesthood of Believers teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is every believer may draw near to god through the one mediator, jesus christ.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Priesthood of Believers calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let priesthood of believers move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
